challenges.title: Independent hash verification
challenges.objective: Independently reproduce the canonical SHA-256 verification of the published MyZubster digital identity artifact and document deterministic steps.
acceptance: Reproduction steps are complete and repeatable
Result is checked against the published integrity reference
No private or unnecessary personal data is collected

challenges.title: Open-source identity verifier
challenges.objective: Implement a small deterministic verifier that validates the identity JSON structure and SHA-256 integrity reference.
acceptance: Verifier runs locally with documented commands
Success and failure cases are tested

challenges.title: Signed identity credential design
challenges.objective: Design and implement a verifiable signed representation of the MyZubster technical identity with public-key verification and key-rotation guidance.
acceptance: Key rotation and revocation/status strategy is documented
Current self-attested status is not misrepresented as government/legal identity certification

challenges.title: Critical impersonation resistance review
challenges.objective: Identify a reproducible weakness in the MyZubster-controlled identity verification flow that could allow a forged technical identity assertion to be accepted as authentic.
acceptance: Finding is reproducible within explicitly authorized MyZubster-controlled scope
No destructive testing or third-party compromise occurs
Sensitive exploit details are privately disclosed before public publication
